title: Engineering Trainer / Assessor
description:
Technical Trainer / Assessor (Engineering)

Location: Newcastle Upon Tyne (fully onsite)
Duration: 6 Months Initially with scope for perm
Rate: TBC - Open to candidate expectations at this time. This will be PAYE/Umbrella.
Start Date: ASAP, will wait for up to 4 week notice

Our client, a leading organisation in the engineering sector, is seeking a dynamic and knowledgeable Technical Trainer (Assessor) to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual passionate about imparting knowledge and fostering skill development in the next generation of engineers.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Technical Trainer, you will play a pivotal role in:

  • Delivering, assessing, and internally verifying engineering courses up to Level 2 in-house.
  • Assessing and internally verifying Level 3 competencies in alignment with apprenticeship standards.
  • Coordinating, tracking, and ensuring the timely completion of all elements of the apprenticeship standard, while mentoring apprentices in the development of their essential knowledge, skills, and behaviours.
  • Developing and maintaining comprehensive engineering course materials, including lesson plans and schemes of work.
  • Utilising OneFile for effective record-keeping, ensuring all relevant evidence of learning is documented accurately for each learner.
  • Reviewing course content and delivery methods to anticipate future needs, while updating working methods, techniques, and personal professional development.

Candidate Requirements:

Our client is looking for suitable candidates who meet the following criteria:

  • Relevant qualifications in Machining, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • A Level 5 Teaching Qualification or equivalent.
  • Training Assessment and Quality Assurance Award (TAQA) - Desired
  • D32/D33 or A1 Assessors Award - Desired
  • D34 or V1 Verifiers Award - Desired
  • The ability to obtain Enhanced DBS security clearance with Adults and Children's Barred lists.

Why Join Our Client?

This organisation is committed to creating a supportive and engaging learning environment, where trainers can inspire and develop future engineers. If you thrive in a role that combines teaching with hands-on engineering, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

How to Apply:

If you are ready to make a significant impact in the engineering community and meet the above criteria, please submit your CV detailing your relevant experience.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to advance your career and contribute to the development of aspiring engineering professionals. Apply today and embark on a fulfilling journey with our client!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.
